description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>InMobi (Corporate)</strong></p> <p>InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Ltd.</p> <p><strong>InMobi Advertising</strong></p> <p>InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.</p> <p><strong>Glance</strong></p> <p>Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Recruitment Fraud Alert</strong></p> <p>We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number. &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What to know:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Commvault does&nbsp;<em>not</em>&nbsp;conduct interviews by email or text.</li> <li>We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.</li> <li>Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.</li> </ul> <p>If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at <u><a href="mailto:wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com">wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com</a>&nbsp;</u></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Commvault</strong></p> <p>Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.</p></div><p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity to join our Business Technology team. As we move toward an AI-driven delivery model, you will design and build end-to-end workflows that orchestrate ServiceNow, cloud platforms, enterprise systems, and AI agents into autonomous flows that resolve requests from intake through completion.</p> <p>The ideal candidate starts with business outcomes and economics—understanding current costs and cycle times, defining target states, and designing the fastest path to achieve them. You will re-engineer processes before automating, determine what can be resolved autonomously versus requiring human intervention, and build the integrations that bring these solutions into production.</p> <h3>What you’ll do… </h3> <ul> <li> <p>Orchestrate cross-platform workflows connecting ServiceNow, cloud services, identity systems, and enterprise applications to enable end-to-end request resolution without manual handoffs</p> </li> <li> <p>Build AI-powered request resolution and autonomous operations (intent detection, diagnosis, and resolution), driving deflection before tickets are created</p> </li> <li> <p>Integrate AI agents into workflows using MCP, tools, and orchestration patterns to pull context, take action, and escalate appropriately</p> </li> <li> <p>Re-engineer processes before automating—eliminating unnecessary steps and designing improved workflows</p> </li> <li> <p>Own automation economics and value realization, including measuring cost and cycle time, modeling improvements, and tracking business impact</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and configure solutions on ServiceNow (Flow Designer, Integration Hub, scoped apps, catalog, Now Assist) alongside automation beyond the platform</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop automation outside of ServiceNow using Python and PowerShell for cloud operations, identity management, monitoring, and scheduling</p> </li> <li> <p>Design workflows that balance automation and human oversight—defining approval points, autonomy boundaries, and ensuring systems operate reliably and safely in production&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Who you are?</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field</p> </li> <li> <p>2–4 years of hands-on experience in software engineering, automation, or ServiceNow development, building production-grade solutions</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with ServiceNow development, including workflow automation (Flow Designer), integrations (REST/webhooks), and platform scripting</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working with authentication (OAuth, bearer tokens) and enterprise data models (e.g., CMDB)</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong automation mindset with the ability to identify what should be orchestrated, automated, or eliminated</p> </li> <li> <p>Solid engineering fundamentals (APIs, system design, data structures, scripting)</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C#, or PowerShell</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building and integrating systems using REST APIs and enterprise platforms</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience delivering end-to-end automation (design, build, deploy, monitor, measure)</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to work backward from business outcomes, with a focus on impact and efficiency</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate in ambiguity and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated self-learning mindset in a rapidly evolving technology landscape</p> </li> <li> <p>Curiosity to understand root causes—building solutions that address patterns, not just symptoms</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong written and verbal English&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Experience across additional ServiceNow modules (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, GRC)</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with ServiceNow capabilities such as Service Portal, UI Builder, Performance Analytics, Now Assist, or Virtual Agent</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building scoped applications (App Engine) and using automated testing frameworks (ATF)</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience applying AI to workflow automation (e.g., request deflection, automated resolution, intent classification at scale)</p> </li> <li> <p>Exposure to agent-based systems or orchestration patterns (e.g., MCP, tool integration, agent handoffs)</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with human-in-the-loop design, guardrails, and workflow governance</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with modern AI and integration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, RAG pipelines)</p> </li> <li> <p>Familiarity with vector databases, observability tooling, monitoring, or process mining</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with integration platforms (e.g., Workato, MuleSoft)</p> </li> <li> <p>ServiceNow certifications (CSA, CAD, CIS, or similar)</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p lang="en-US" style="margin: 0in; margin-left: .375in; font-family: Calibri; font-size: 11.0pt;">#LI-VK</p> <div class="content-intro"><p>Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!</p></div><p>As a Technical Quality Specialist on the Customer Support team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping how Figma identifies, diagnoses, and resolves complex product issues at scale. As a founding member of our Bangalore team, you’ll help establish quality standards, influence workflows, and build strong partnerships with Engineering and Product.</p> <p>We are looking for a Technical Quality Specialist who will drive quality improvements across the support and product lifecycle. This role goes beyond resolving issues—you’ll identify patterns, lead root cause analysis, and partner with Engineering and Product to improve reliability and customer experience at scale. The ideal candidate brings strong technical depth, systems thinking, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.</p> <p>Coverage outside standard business hours is part of this role. Your shift hours will be one of the following:</p> <ul> <li>Wednesday to Sunday, 12.30pm - 9.30pm IST</li> <li>Thursday to Monday, 12.30pm - 9.30pm IST</li> <li>Friday to Tuesday, 12.30pm - 9.30pm IST</li> </ul> <p>This role will be held from our Bengaluru office (in Koramangala) on a hybrid basis.</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do at Figma:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Develop deep expertise in Figma’s products, architecture, and customer workflows to diagnose complex technical issues</li> <li>Interact with Figma customers daily via support channels such as chat, email, or video calls, taking ownership over complex problems</li> <li>Own end-to-end resolution of high-impact bugs, partnering closely with Engineering and Product to drive timely and effective fixes, and maintain clear, proactive communication to improve customer satisfaction</li> <li>Contribute to social support efforts by engaging with customers and users on social media and community platforms</li> <li>Adapt to supporting customers across multiple products, including assisting with billing and account management issues as needed. Maintain schedule flexibility, including occasional weekend or holiday coverage, to support customers globally</li> <li>Recommend and implement improvements to debugging workflows, tooling, and support operations</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally to create internal documentation, training materials, and scalable knowledge systems</li> <li>Act as the voice of the customer by identifying trends and communicating insights to our Product and Engineering teams to advocate for bug fixes, tooling and process improvements, and feature enhancements</li> </ul> <h4><strong>We'd love to hear from you if you have:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience in Technical Support, Support Engineering, or QA within a SaaS environment</li> <li>Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, including REST APIs, OAuth authentication flows, and third-party integrations</li> <li>Working knowledge of modern web technologies, including JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and React</li> <li>Ability to collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to resolve complex technical issues, with strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills</li> <li>Comfortable navigating fast-paced, ambiguous environments, with a focus on end-to-end issue resolution and continuous process improvement</li> </ul> <h4><strong>While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience working with design tools like Figma, Adobe Suite, Sketch, Framer</li> </ul> <p>At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2022-10/EEOC_KnowYourRights_screen_reader_10_20.pdf">equal opportunity workplace</a> - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status<strong>, </strong>or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.</p> <p>We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to <a href="mailto:accommodations-ext@figma.com">accommodations-ext@figma.com</a>. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.&nbsp;</p> <p>Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Holding interviews in an accessible location</li> <li>Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing</li> <li>Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers</li> <li>Changing the mode or format of interviews&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.</p> <p>By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://www.figma.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.figma.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice/" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p><strong>Application limits:</strong> To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:</p> <ul> <li>Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.</li> <li>Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.</li> </ul> <p>Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.</p></div>
